spec.name: Lionheart Gunblade
spec.description: A Final Fantasy-style revolver gunblade planted point-down in the ground after battle, its silver chain hanging slack behind the blade.
spec.layout: One vertical gunblade standing on its planted tip at x=0, front (+Z) is the polished cutting edge. From the ground up: a steel blade tapering from 0.16 m wide at the guard seat to a point sunk 2 cm into the floor, carrying a dark blood groove, a light polished edge strip and a row of spine teeth on the back (−Z) edge. At y 1.28–1.56 the ornate guard wraps the blade and carries the revolver mechanism: an 8-fluted drum with its axis along Z at [0, 1.42, 0.02], a brass-banded barrel pointing forward to a muzzle at z 0.34, a curved spur hammer at the back top and a trigger in a brass loop under the drum. Above the guard a back-leaning leather grip rises to a gold pommel dome with a glowing ruby at y 1.90. From the pommel a silver chain hangs down the back of the model, swaying behind the blade to about y 0.72 at z −0.56. The style is faceted low-poly metalwork: cool steel against warm brass and gold trim, dark gunmetal mechanism, ivory side-plate medallions, a glowing blue rune near the blade base and a glowing ruby pommel stone as the only magic.

parts.builds: The planted blade, tip down. Main body: a flat tapered slab drawn as a faceted extrude facing ±X, silhouette from the point at y 0.02 rising to full width 0.16 m at the guardSeat mount y 1.30, with a gentle forward (+Z) sweep of the edge and a slight recurve near the tip; thickness about 0.035 m; wears steel. Details as their own seated parts: a polished cutting-edge strip (edge) running the full +Z edge from tip to guard; a narrow blood groove (gunmetalDark) inset down the blade centre face on both sides; the back spine (−Z) shaded steelDark. Seven staggered triangular teeth (steelDark bodies, brassLight tips) project backward from the −Z edge between y 0.35 and y 1.05, largest near the base. At y 0.22 a winged emblem plate on both flats: an ivory disc with a gold winged lion silhouette in gold over it, held by two silver rivets. Two faint chevron runes (runeGlow, glowing) flanking the emblem at y 0.32 and y 0.14, small extrudes seated flush on the flats. Two brass collar rivets at the top where the blade enters the guard.
parts.attaches: The blade's top face ends exactly at mount guardSeat [0, 1.30, 0], where the gunCore's wing plates and drum wrap around it; the tip sinks 2 cm below y 0.

parts.builds: The guard and revolver mechanism. Guard: two broad swept wing plates (faceted extrudes facing ±X, gunmetal) rising from the blade seat to wrap the drum, each trimmed with a brass edge band, three brassLight rivets and a small steelDark underline shadow where the wing meets the drum. Revolver drum: a lathe cylinder, axis +Z, centre at mount cylinderAxis, radius 0.085, length 0.20, gunmetal, with eight brass flute ridges running its length and a brassLight centre band; its rear face is a gunmetalDark plate. Barrel: a gunmetal tube radius 0.032 from z 0.10 to z 0.34 forward (+Z), with a brassLight muzzle ring, a black bore disc, and a small brass front-sight blade on top. Hammer: rides joint hammer, a curved gunmetalDark spur with a steelDark face and a brassLight pin at its pivot, swept up and back from the drum's top rear. Trigger: rides joint trigger, a small curved steelDark trigger blade hanging inside a brass trigger-guard loop that arcs from the drum's underside forward to the gripSeat mount. Side plates: an ivory plate with a gold lion-head medallion and three silver screws on each flat of the drum. A small steelDark rear-sight notch sits on the drum top.
parts.attaches: Wing plates clamp the blade at mount guardSeat; the drum barrel axis runs through mount cylinderAxis; the trigger-guard loop lands on mount gripSeat where the grip enters.

parts.builds: The grip and pommel above the mechanism. Grip core: a slightly back-leaning tapered frustum sweep from mount gripSeat [0, 1.56, 0.02] to mount pommelCap [0, 1.90, -0.06], square-ish section 0.055 m at the collar shrinking to 0.04 m at the pommel, wearing gripLeather. Wraps: five diagonal leather bands (gripWrap) evenly spaced up the grip, each with a tiny brass stud at both ends, plus a diamond column of ivory inlay studs (four, alternating offsets) down the front (+Z) face. Collar: a brass ring with a brassLight bevel where the grip enters the guard at gripSeat. Pommel: a gold lathe dome cap with a brassLight rim ring seated on the pommel joint at pommelCap, holding a faceted emberRed ruby (glowing) set into its back face; a small brass ring mount projects from the pommel's back at chainRoot [0, 1.88, -0.09] where the chain roots.
parts.attaches: Bottom of the grip enters the gunCore at mount gripSeat inside the trigger-guard loop; the pommel cap closes on mount pommelCap and hands the chain off at mount chainRoot.

parts.builds: The hanging chain and charm. Chain: about fourteen alternating links swept along the chain1..chain4 joints from mount chainRoot downward behind the blade — short silver capsules (rod sweeps) alternating 90° orientation link to link, each with a tiny steelDark inner shadow ring so the links read as open metal. The chain follows the joints' gentle backward sway, ending at the last link around y 0.72, z −0.56. Charm: from the final link hangs a talisman — a small gold triangle frame (extrude) with a faceted emberRed crystal (glowing) inside it, a brassLight cap on the crystal, and two ivory beads on a short silver drop wire above the frame.
parts.attaches: Roots at mount chainRoot on the pommel's ring mount and hangs clear behind the blade, never touching it; the lowest link stays above y 0.62.
